title: Train hopping callback waits for a getter read
Negative acceleration marks gravity simulations done immediately
evidence: In physics__gravity__negative_acceleration_threshold, both positions are 0 with end=100 at frame 0. Flutter reports done=0 and Incular reports done=1.
impact: A negative-acceleration simulation starting below its positive threshold can be treated as finished before it moves.
cause: The Incular completion check compares position to the threshold based on acceleration sign rather than comparing absolute position to the threshold.
fix_direction: Use abs(position) >= end for either acceleration sign.

title: Empty SizedBox claims hits

cause: Flutter closes the arena on pointer-down and defaults a singleton arena to its sole member; the accepted scroll drag consumes the first move. Incular has no close/default-singleton path, so its DragStartBehavior::Start threshold branch drops that first 40 px move.
impact: Every later sampled scroll offset remains 40 px apart; settled offsets at 1568 ms are 1193.7479 vs 1153.7479.
title: Singleton scroll arena drops the first drag move
fix_direction: Mirror Flutter close-after-down and singleton default-winner behavior while retaining arbitration for competing members.

cause: Flutter's dedicated DoubleTapGestureRecognizer stores the first tap independently. Incular records last_tap only inside the regular tap/tap-up/tap-cancel callback branch; with only on_double_tap, the first pointer-up rejects without saving the first tap.
impact: GestureDetector configured with onDoubleTap alone never fires its callback in Incular.
title: Double-tap-only detector does not retain the first tap
fix_direction: Track first-tap state independently from onTap callbacks, matching Flutter's separate recognizer lifecycle.

cause: Flutter invokes onLongPress together with onLongPressStart when the deadline expires. Incular's poll action emits LongPressStart only; its separate LongPress action dispatching on_long_press is returned from pointer-up handling.
impact: The public onLongPress callback is delayed until pointer-up; while the pointer remains down after the timeout, Incular has only fired onLongPressStart.
title: onLongPress fires on release instead of at the deadline
fix_direction: Dispatch onLongPress at the deadline alongside onLongPressStart; keep onLongPressEnd at release.

cause: Flutter's sole scale recognizer wins the arena closed after pointer-down and acceptGesture starts a possible scale immediately. Incular has no singleton default arena winner and waits for focal-point movement to cross pan slop.
impact: Scale onStart timing differs on touch-down even for a one-pointer scale gesture; downstream consumers initialize transforms at different times.

first_divergence.event_state: after pointer-down and before first move

title: Single-pointer scale starts at different times
fix_direction: Resolve singleton arenas on pointer-down and recheck scale start and competing drag behavior.
additional_scenario: gestures__scale__two_pointer_pinch: frame 3 scale Flutter 1.5 vs Incular 1.0; frame 4 1.8333 vs 1.0

impact: LongPressDraggable can begin a drag without Flutter's 500 ms hold, changing drag-target acceptance and gesture arbitration.
title: LongPressDraggable maps to immediate Draggable

Controller value listeners are change-gated
additional_evidence: After same-value assignment at frame 5 / 80 ms, Flutter increments the listener count and Incular does not.
impact: Controller listeners miss Flutter callbacks on the first zero-elapsed tick and on equal-value assignments.
cause: Public listener dispatch shares the state-change guard used for reactive invalidation.
fix_direction: Dispatch value listeners on every controller tick and value setter while keeping dependency invalidation change-sensitive if needed.

title: First forward status notification is suppressed for an intermediate initial value
impact: A status listener registered before the first run does not receive Flutter's initial forward transition when the controller starts at an interior value.
cause: Incular initializes the reported-status baseline from the initial value; Flutter keeps the baseline at dismissed until dispatch.
fix_direction: Initialize the reported-status baseline independently from the current value to match Flutter's first-run notification behavior.

title: Scheduler-wide time dilation is not implemented
evidence_type: missing API demonstrated with a diagnostic frame trace
evidence_note: Flutter's global timeDilation = 2 has no Incular scheduler equivalent. Incular's retained animation scale was set to 0.5 only to keep controller progress comparable; the direct Ticker remains raw. These are non-equivalent configurations, so this is a missing-API finding rather than a same-input parity failure.
impact: Incular callers cannot slow scheduler timestamps, ticker callbacks, and self-ticking controllers together as Flutter does.
cause: Incular scales the retained widget animation clock rather than all frame timestamps; it has no scheduler-wide time-dilation API.
fix_direction: Add scheduler-level time scaling for frame timestamps, or extend a per-runtime time scale to all tickers and frame callbacks.

title: Derived animations cannot register Flutter-style listeners
impact: Callers cannot attach value or status listeners to curved, reversed, driven, or compound animation values; they must listen to underlying controllers and recompute the graph.
cause: AnimationSource and DoubleAnimation expose sampled values and controller dependencies but no listener protocol.
fix_direction: Expose listener subscriptions on graph nodes or provide an adapter that propagates derived value and status notifications.

title: with_vsync tickers do not inherit TickerMode
impact: An ancestor TickerMode does not automatically silence a self-ticking with_vsync controller; callers must manually wire set_ticker_muted.
cause: The self-scheduling ticker has no widget or environment provider connection, while automatic muting is applied to retained AnimationTicker nodes.
fix_direction: Connect controller ticker mute state to a widget-aware ticker provider or make the ownership relationship explicit in the public API.

title: Size and rectangle tweens clamp extrapolated extents
additional_evidence: At progress 2, size height is -20 vs 0 and RectTween right/bottom edges are 190 vs 200.
impact: Overshooting parents can produce negative sizes in Flutter, while Incular truncates dimensions to zero; rect edges diverge as a result.
cause: Incular's Size interpolation clamps negative dimensions in the extrapolation path.
fix_direction: Preserve signed dimensions in tween interpolation while enforcing non-negative extents at layout APIs that require them.

title: Tween sequences choose the previous item at an exact boundary
additional_evidence: At progress 0.5, Flutter assigns the boundary to the next item; Incular returns the prior item. The flipped sequence sample is 0.3 vs 0.8.
impact: A sequence with different adjacent endpoints returns different values exactly at the transition boundary.
cause: Incular uses an inclusive upper bound; Flutter intervals use [start, end) for non-final segments.
fix_direction: Use a strict upper-bound comparison for non-final segments and retain the last segment for progress 1.

title: Flipped tween sequences have no direct Incular equivalent
evidence_note: The Rust twin calculates 1 - sequence(1 - t) inline because TweenSequence is not an Animatable and there is no FlippedTweenSequence type.
impact: Callers must implement the sequence reversal and value inversion themselves instead of using a reusable animatable type.
cause: No flipped sequence wrapper exists, and TweenSequence is not wired into Animatable composition.
fix_direction: Implement Animatable for TweenSequence and provide a wrapper that computes 1 - sequence(1 - t).

title: Color, size, and rect tweens do not accept nullable endpoints
evidence_note: Flutter ColorTween accepts null and fades alpha without changing RGB; Flutter SizeTween and RectTween treat null as zero. Incular aliases store concrete begin/end values and cannot represent None.
impact: Callers cannot directly express Flutter's nullable color fade or absent size/rect endpoints through the typed tween APIs.
cause: The Incular tween aliases use non-optional Color, Size, and Rect endpoints.
fix_direction: Add nullable endpoint support or dedicated tween variants that preserve Flutter's null interpolation semantics.

title: Sliver opacity starts one frame late

evidence.additional_evidence: At frame 5 / 80 ms Incular equals Flutter's frame-4 opacity; both reach 0.25 at frame 26.
evidence.impact: The visible opacity trajectory lags Flutter's by one frame during the fade, then converges to the same target.
evidence.cause: Retained sliver adoption schedules forward_on_next_tick after the current frame's tick; Flutter starts the controller during didUpdateWidget.
evidence.fix_direction: Establish the adopted animation before the first post-update tick so its elapsed timeline matches Flutter.

title: Implicit layout widgets cannot animate directional geometry

evidence.impact: Callers cannot preserve start/end alignment or insets in RTL layouts through AnimatedContainer, AnimatedPadding, AnimatedAlign, or AnimatedFractionallySizedBox, and cannot interpolate mixed directional and physical geometry.
evidence.cause: Implicit widget setters and tween storage accept concrete Alignment and EdgeInsets values; Incular's separate directional types are not accepted by those APIs.
evidence.fix_direction: Accept Flutter-equivalent geometry enums and interpolate them with direction-aware geometry lerps.

title: Opacity widgets cannot match Flutter's semantic visibility option

evidence.impact: At zero opacity, assistive technology may still announce or navigate Incular child content that Flutter hides by default; callers cannot choose Flutter's alwaysIncludeSemantics behavior.
evidence.cause: Incular opacity is paint-only for semantic exposure and has no always-include flag.
evidence.fix_direction: Add the flag to box and sliver opacity widgets and propagate it into semantics projection, defaulting to Flutter's false behavior.

title: AnimatedPhysicalModel has no circular shape option

evidence.impact: Callers cannot create Flutter's circular physical model or match its clip and shadow silhouette.
evidence.cause: The Incular widget models corner radii but has no rectangle/circle shape field.
evidence.fix_direction: Add shape to the widget and renderer-neutral physical-model descriptor, then support the matching paint and clip behavior.

Spring simulations estimate velocity with a forward difference
evidence: In physics__spring__damping_regimes, frame 0 / 0 ms reports dx=30 for all Flutter regimes and 34.8282 (under), 34.6680 (critical), 34.3399 (over) in Incular. The direct scroll spring also reports 0 vs 4.9438 at frame 0. Position remains within tolerance.
impact: Spring consumers receive velocity from one millisecond ahead; the same value feeds completion checks and scroll handoffs.
cause: Incular estimates dx as (x(t + 1 ms) - x(t)) / 1 ms instead of using the closed-form derivative.
fix_direction: Use the analytic derivative for each damping regime in velocity and completion checks.

title: Bounded friction changes velocity and omits the bound-distance tolerance
evidence: In physics__bounded_friction__position_and_velocity, frame 3 / 48 ms has clamped x=4: Flutter dx=90.8356, Incular dx=0. In physics__bounded_friction__distance_tolerance, start=3.9995 is 0.0005 from max=4 under the 0.001 default distance tolerance; Flutter is done at frame 0, Incular is not, and at frame 1 Flutter dx=96.8468 while Incular dx=0.
impact: Consumers lose the inner friction velocity at a display bound, and a position already within Flutter's settling tolerance continues in Incular.
cause: Incular zeros velocity at bounds and tests exact raw-position crossing rather than distance from the clamped position to the bound.
fix_direction: Preserve the inner friction velocity and apply tolerance.distance to the clamped position when checking bounds.

title: Clamped simulations cannot clamp velocity
evidence: Source review; the diagnostic twin sets Flutter dxMax=50 while Incular has no equivalent option. Frame 0 reports Flutter 50 vs Incular 200; configurations are intentionally not equivalent.
impact: Callers cannot cap velocity independently from position as Flutter's ClampedSimulation allows.
cause: Incular's constructor stores only position bounds and forwards the inner velocity unchanged.
fix_direction: Add optional dxMin/dxMax bounds and clamp the forwarded velocity.

title: SpringDescription duration and bounce getters are missing
evidence: Source review. The duration/bounce frame twin reads Flutter's getters and reconstructs the same formulas in test code because the Incular type has no equivalent accessors.
impact: Callers cannot query the perceptual duration or bounce of an existing spring description through Incular's public API.
cause: The Rust type exposes only the physical coefficients and constructors.
fix_direction: Add duration and bounce accessors with Flutter's derivation and rounding.

title: SpringSimulation lacks snapToEnd
evidence: Source review. Direct frame twins use Flutter's default snapToEnd=false; Incular has no equivalent configuration for the true case. Its ScrollSpringSimulation snaps position but leaves the inherited velocity unchanged.
impact: Callers cannot request Flutter's endpoint-and-zero-velocity behavior on a general spring simulation.
cause: Endpoint snapping is available only through a separate scroll wrapper, with position-only snapping.
fix_direction: Add a snap_to_end option that snaps both position and velocity after completion.

title: FrictionSimulation omits Flutter's desktop and endpoint helpers
evidence: Source review. The ordinary zero-constant-deceleration curve is frame-tested and matches; Flutter's constantDeceleration, through constructor, finalX, and timeAtX have no public counterpart on Incular's animation simulation.
impact: Callers cannot use Flutter's desktop constant-deceleration behavior or tune/query friction motion through endpoints using the Incular animation type.
cause: The animation crate implements only the basic exponential decay; similar through behavior is private to scroll ballistics.
fix_direction: Expose constant deceleration, a through constructor, final position, and time-at-position on the animation friction type.

title: Simulation tolerance is not available through the trait
evidence: Source review. Concrete Incular constructors may accept a tolerance, but generic simulation users cannot inspect or update a shared tolerance through the Simulation trait.
impact: Code that adjusts tolerance after construction or handles simulations through a base interface cannot be ported directly.
cause: The Rust trait exposes only the three time-sampled methods.
fix_direction: Expose tolerance through the simulation abstraction or document a builder-based equivalent.

AnimatedCrossFade outgoing child keeps its narrow width
impact: Outgoing child remains narrow and is horizontally offset while cross-fading to a wider child.
cause: The matching left/top/right placement does not deliver the effective stack width to Incular's outgoing subtree under its transition wrappers.
fix_direction: Trace two-sided Positioned width constraints through the retained opacity/semantics wrappers and make the bottom subtree adopt the computed stack width.

title: AnimatedSize retarget uses the previous animation tick
impact: A mid-flight target change advances one additional frame toward the old target before reversing, moving the box visibly.
cause: Incular observes the child's new size after the current frame's animation tick has already sized the parent; Flutter updates its target before computing that frame's size.
fix_direction: Apply target-size changes in the same layout pass as the outer-size calculation, starting from the last displayed size.

title: AnimatedSwitcher transition builder receives a scalar
evidence_detail: The default transition trace matches, but the callback signatures differ: Flutter passes Animation<double>; Incular passes only f32.
impact: Custom builders cannot inspect status, pass the animation to another transition, or compose/listen to its animation graph.
cause: Incular reduces the callback input to its sampled fraction.
fix_direction: Expose a cloneable animation handle with value and status on the transition-builder callback.

title: AnimatedModalBarrier cannot animate to null color
evidence_detail: The twin animates between two non-null colors and matches; Flutter accepts Animation<Color?> while Incular requires Animation<Color>.
impact: The Incular API cannot express a no-fill endpoint while retaining barrier interaction behavior.
cause: The barrier animation value is non-nullable in Incular.
fix_direction: Support optional sampled colors and keep hit testing and semantics active when the color is None.

title: SliverAnimatedList builder omits its item animation
evidence_detail: The initial two-row layout matches; Flutter's item builder receives Animation<double>, while Incular's receives only usize.
impact: User item builders cannot apply per-item fade, slide, or other insertion/removal transitions in Incular's SliverAnimatedList.
cause: Incular keeps the extent animation internal and omits it from the item builder arguments.
fix_direction: Expose retained item animation progress or a handle to the sliver-list item builder.

title: SlideTransition cannot resolve its horizontal offset from text direction
evidence: Flutter negates the horizontal offset for RTL when textDirection is rtl; Incular samples the Offset directly into FractionalTranslation and exposes no direction parameter. The paired scenario uses LTR, where values match.

title: SlideTransition cannot disable hit-test transforms
evidence: Flutter exposes transformHitTests and passes it to FractionalTranslation; Incular's transition constructs FractionalTranslation with its default true and exposes no setter.

title: Matrix, scale and rotation transitions omit filterQuality
evidence: The frame scenario transitions geometry and matches without filtering. Flutter's constructors carry filterQuality to Transform while active; the Incular transition and Transform descriptors have no such field.

title: RelativePositionedTransition cannot represent a nullable rectangle
evidence: Flutter accepts Animation<Rect?> and maps null to Rect.zero; Incular requires TweenAnimation<Rect>. The non-null twin matches.

title: DecoratedBoxTransition only accepts BoxDecoration
evidence: Flutter accepts Animation<Decoration>; Incular requires TweenAnimation<BoxDecoration>. The BoxDecoration color interpolation twin matches.

title: SliverFadeTransition requires an OpacityController
evidence: Flutter accepts Animation<double>; Incular accepts OpacityController. Direct opacity assignments produce matching traces, but an arbitrary derived animation cannot be supplied.

title: SizeTransition clamps negative fixed cross-axis factors instead of asserting
evidence: The valid fixedCrossAxisSizeFactor twin matches. Flutter asserts the factor is non-negative; Incular clamps a negative factor to zero.

title: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle has intermittent one-pixel line-box drift

evidence.additional_evidence: Frame 0 matches. Horizontal widths differ by less than 0.00002 px while top and bottom differ by 0.5 px on five intermediate frames; adjacent frames sometimes match.
evidence.impact: A text widget's layout bounds can shift by one logical pixel during a font-size animation and move nearby content.
evidence.cause: Tween progress and text width agree; the observed difference is in line-box metrics at fractional font sizes, likely text-engine metric rounding.
evidence.fix_direction: Compare Flutter and Incular line metrics for the same Inter font sizes and align fractional-size line-box rounding.

title: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle omits Flutter paragraph options

evidence.impact: Callers cannot configure inherited paragraph wrapping, truncation, alignment, or line-height behavior through Incular's animated style widget.
evidence.cause: Incular's AnimatedDefaultTextStyle stores only TextStyle, child, and timing.
evidence.fix_direction: Add Flutter's paragraph options to AnimatedDefaultTextStyle and pass them through to the default-style scope.

title: Baseline-aligned small text is shifted by 0.625 px
Completion comparisons are inclusive at Flutter's strict tolerance boundary
evidence: physics__friction__tolerance_boundary uses velocity=tolerance=0.001 and reports done=0 in Flutter vs 1 in Incular at frame 0. physics__spring__tolerance_boundary starts exactly one distance tolerance from equilibrium and reports done=0 vs 1 at frame 0.
impact: A simulation exactly on the tolerance edge can stop one evaluation earlier in Incular.
cause: Incular uses <= where Flutter uses strict comparisons through nearZero.
fix_direction: Use strict comparisons for friction velocity and spring distance/velocity tolerance checks.

title: Spring descriptions normalize inputs Flutter preserves
evidence: physics__spring_description__damping_regimes at frame 0: raw (mass=0, stiffness=0, damping=-1) remains unchanged in Flutter and becomes (1,100,10) in Incular. A damping ratio of -0.25 gives damping=-5/type=under in Flutter and damping=20/type=critical in Incular.
impact: The same parameters can select a different spring regime and produce different motion for unusual or invalid physical inputs.
cause: Incular adds default substitutions for invalid mass, stiffness, damping, and ratio that Flutter's constructors do not apply.
fix_direction: Preserve supplied values, or document the sanitization as an intentional API difference.

title: Duration and bounce spring creation retains sub-millisecond precision
evidence: physics__spring_description__duration_bounce passes 300500 µs and bounce=0.3. Flutter reports stiffness=438.6491, damping=29.3215, duration=300 ms; Incular computes stiffness=437.1906, damping=29.2727, and duration=301 ms from its spring fields.
impact: Sub-millisecond duration inputs produce different spring timing and damping.
cause: Incular converts full microsecond duration to fractional seconds while Flutter first truncates to whole milliseconds.
fix_direction: Use whole milliseconds before deriving stiffness when Flutter parity is intended.

title: nearEqual and nearZero have no public Incular equivalent
evidence: Source review; the inventory marked both helpers unresolved. Incular has only a private scroll-local near_zero helper.
impact: Callers cannot reuse Flutter's null-aware near-equality and near-zero checks from Incular's public physics API.
cause: The helper is local to scroll spring completion instead of a shared public utility.
fix_direction: Add public near_equal and near_zero functions if parity with Flutter's exported physics utilities is desired.

title: AnimatedSize reverseDuration API surface differs
flutter_value: accepted but not used by the inspected forward-only path
evidence_detail: Flutter accepts reverseDuration, but Flutter 3.41.7 RenderAnimatedSize only calls forward/forward(from: 0.0) at rendering/animated_size.dart:309-374; no reverse() call was found.
impact: No reachable runtime timing difference was established; this is a source-level configuration difference only.
cause: The Incular widget configuration stores only one duration.
fix_direction: No behavioral change is indicated; add the property only if source-level API compatibility is required.

title: AnimatedWidget has no direct public base equivalent
evidence: Flutter provides a subclassable listening widget base; Incular provides an internal retained helper and public closure-based AnimatedBuilder/ListenableBuilder instead. The builder twins match, while custom subclass lifecycle is not represented.

title: RelativeRectTween has no named public counterpart
evidence: Flutter exposes RelativeRectTween; Incular uses RelativeRect with a generic TweenAnimation. The positioned twin uses this generic replacement.
